Shabbos Parshas Bereishis

Tishrei 5751

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the double mention of Noach in the verse alludes to the two aspects of Shabbos, Erev Shabbos and Shabbos day, which correspond to rest for the lower and upper realms.
section.t: “These are the generations of Noach, Noach…”1,
and the Tzemach Tzedek explains in his maamar beginning with this phrase2,
that the matter of “Noach, Noach” twice is,
that Noach is the aspect of Shabbos
(as will be explained),
and on Shabbos there are two aspects,
as the Sages said3,
“If Israel would keep two Shabbasos according to their law, they would immediately be redeemed,”
and it is known4,
that the explanation of “two Shabbasos” is5
the two Shabbasos that exist in every Shabbos6,
Erev Shabbos and Shabbos day.
Therefore “Noach, Noach” is said twice,
corresponding to7
the two Shabbasos in every Shabbos,
Erev Shabbos and Shabbos day.
And the maamar adds2,
that this explanation that Noach is Shabbos is based on what is stated in the Midrash8,
that “Noach, Noach” twice is rest for him and rest for the world,
rest for the fathers and rest for the children,
rest for the upper ones and rest for the lower ones,
rest in this world and rest in the World to Come.
And this statement
(of the Midrash)
that Noach is an expression of rest also includes the explanation that Noach is the aspect of Shabbos,
for regarding Shabbos it is written9,
“And He rested on the seventh day.”
And “Noach, Noach” twice are the lower Shabbos and the upper Shabbos,
which are6
Erev Shabbos and Shabbos day.
And it can be said,
that the reason for this, that he explains again
(after bringing proof from the Midrash that Noach is the aspect of Shabbos)
that “Noach, Noach” are Erev Shabbos and Shabbos day,
is,
in order to hint,
that the connection of the explanation in the maamar with the explanation in the Midrash is regarding Noach
[from this that Noach is an expression of rest it is proven that Noach is the aspect of Shabbos]
and regarding “Noach, Noach” twice.
For the explanation
(in the maamar)
that “Noach, Noach” are the lower Shabbos
[Erev Shabbos]
and the upper Shabbos
[Shabbos day]
is in the manner of the Midrash’s explanation that “Noach, Noach” are rest for the upper ones and rest for the lower ones10.
And the concept is,
that Erev Shabbos
(the ascent of Malchus)
in the service of man is the refinement and elevation of the body and the Nefesh HaBahamis11,
the lower aspect in man12,
and Shabbos day
(the drawing down of Z’eir Anpin)
is the drawing down of the revelation of the Nefesh HaElokis11,
the upper aspect in man12.
And through Israel keeping the two Shabbasos,
through which is brought about the rest
(from matters that confuse one from serving G-d)
both in the lower aspect in man and in the upper aspect in man,
through this the revelation of rest is drawn from above throughout all the worlds,
in the upper ones and in the lower ones,
rest for the upper ones and rest for the lower ones13.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section elaborates that the double nature of Shabbos relates to the principle that all Shabbos matters are doubled, and explains how love and fear permeate both the soul and body, and vice versa.
section.t: B)
And the explanation of the concept in more detail,
will be understood by prefacing what is explained in many places14
[and also in the aforementioned maamar of the Tzemach Tzedek15]
that the two Shabbasos that exist in every Shabbos relate to the fact that all Shabbos matters are doubled16.
And this is “If Israel would keep two Shabbasos according to their law, they would immediately be redeemed,”
for doubling relates to redemption17.
And it can be said,
that in the Sages’ statement “all Shabbos matters are doubled” is also included that each of the two Shabbasos is doubled,
meaning that each of them is comprised of both of them.
And the concept is,
that love and fear are
(in general)
the service that comes from the soul
(Shabbos day)
and the performance of practical mitzvos is the service that comes from the body
(Erev Shabbos).
And the concept of “all Shabbos matters are doubled” is,
that the love of G-d that comes from the soul
(the upper aspect in man)
should be drawn into the animal soul and the body
(the lower aspect in man),
as it is written18,
“And you shall love the L-rd your G-d with all your heart”
(with two hearts),
that the love should be in the right chamber, the place of the dwelling of the G-dly soul, and in the left chamber, the place of the dwelling of the animal soul,
as the Sages said19,
“With all your heart – with both your inclinations”20.
And beyond this – “with all your soul,”
that the love spreads into all the faculties and limbs
(and it can be said that it is like one who runs21
to perform a mitzvah)22,
and beyond this – “with all your might,”
that his love for G-d is drawn and recognizable also in his portion in the world
(“with all your might – with all your money”23),
and the conclusion of the passage is24,
“And you shall write them upon the doorposts of your house and upon your gates,”
that through the mezuzah that he affixes at the entrance of his house it is recognizable25
that G-d is One, He is the ruler and He is the guardian of the house and all that is within it26,
and He guards the man also when he leaves his house,
“G-d will guard your going and your coming from now and forever”27.
And similarly on the other side,
that the performance of practical mitzvos
(service that comes from the body)
must be with love and fear
(service that comes from the soul).
